notes.title: New Year, New Updates
notes.content:
It’s a new year! Over the past few months, we’ve continued to make a few updates to Necroball to make the experience more fluid, more crisp, and more intuitive.

Our retro game design specialist, Diamonick, has been actively studying the game and finds new ways to improve it— from visual acuity to actual gameplay to the overall function of the game.  

It’s always been very important to us to keep to our retro roots, while taking inspiration from other games we love, to continue to mold the perfect Necromantic experience. 

[h2]Some key updates included in Launch:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Upgraded UI/UX
[*] Controller and Ability callouts have been updated for clarity
[*] Streamlined Experience/ More First Time User Friendly
[*] Inclusion of Tooltips and Gameplay Gifs
[*] Balancing
[*] Enemy AI Adjustments and Character Ability Updates
[*] Graphical Overhaul
[*] New Screens, Minions, and Maps
[/list]

[h2]Post-Launch Updates Included in this week’s patch:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Bug Fixes
[*] Graphical & Quality of Life Updates
[/list]

For a more detailed list of what’s included in the patch update, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/563410/view/3135068277053049705]click here[/url]. 

To play the latest version, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/563410/Necroball/]click here[/url].  

-King Crow Studios

notes.title: Detailed Patch Update Notes
notes.content:
Here's a list of detailed patch notes for this round of updates to NECROBALL:

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Various UI fixes
[*] Fixed HP regen during Soul Shield
[*] Fixed Summoning Circle overlap
[*] Fixed issue with Pause Screen interaction
[*] Fixed Ultimate Necroball animation
[*] Fixed pumpkin head zombie clipping
[*] Fixed Franken Monster health bar graphical error
[*] Fixed Tombstone Upgrade input
[*] Fixed issue where Players could move a dying Player off screen
[*] Fixed issues with Menu navigation
[*] Fixed unintended exploit with Upgraded Tombstones
[*] Updated old animations on the Loading Screen
[/list]

[h1]Graphical & Quality of Life Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Graphical Update to Power Up Collection
[*] Graphical Update to Power Up Text
[*] Graphical Update to Player Character UI (indicator arrow that is only shown locally, small health bar next to character on field, blinking indicator when player health has reached critical/red condition)
[*] Outline added to Minions to distinguish between armies
[*] Graphical Update to the Summoning Circle ability
[*] Background Music added to Menus
[*] Death Timer Increased
[*] Implementation of the New Intro Screen
[*] Graphical Update to the Mausoleum Torches
[*] Graphical Update to Lightning Rod Sprite
[*] Graphical Update to Results Screen
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.3 - Steam Trading Cards are here!
notes.content:
Hello Everybody!

Steam Trading Cards have arrived! 
Collect 'em all to unlock unique Necroball emoticons, Steam Profile backgrounds, and coupons for other games!

In addition to that we've made some bug fixes, changes, and for this week Necroball is 25% off!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/563410/

Please leave a review and let us know what you think of Necroball! We only need a few more reviews to get our positive rating to the public.

If you would like to know more about Steam Trading Cards, go here: https://steamcommunity.com/tradingcards

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27366159/fee1dc05eaf04c95596ce1a938361a81d8135bac.png[/img]

PATCH NOTES 1.3:

- Removed the health bars on tombstones. This helps reduce the visual clutter and the tombstones already change their sprites to show more damaged versions as they lose hit points.
- All games are 5 minutes long. This currently solves a high-severity multiplayer bug that crashes the game at some point after 5 minutes have been played. Once we solve the issue, game time options will be reactivated.
- Removed damage numbers inside the projectile impact animations. These were originally for us to track damage buffs to make sure they were working and now that we know they are, we have removed the numbers to help reduce visual clutter.

SOME THINGS WE ARE STILL WORKING ON:
- Bugs involving team names being incorrectly assigned when playing multiple games in a row.
- Multiplayer Necroball sync issues.
- Ability modifications (lots of abilities will change in the next patch for the better!)
- Improved aiming mechanics and reticles

Thanks for playing!

-King Crow Studios

notes.title: Update 1.2 - Multiplayer Bugs & Minion Balance
notes.content:
Hello Everybody!

We put out a patch earlier this week and have been testing it's efficiency with great success! There was a lot of work done around fixing some Necroball multiplayer authority issues involving who owns the Necroball after collision between the host and client.

While the desync happens much less often than it used to, it might still occur and if you see it please send us a bug report to bugs@kingcrowstudios.com or leave a post on our community forum here!

http://steamcommunity.com/app/563410/discussions/

Keep sending us bug reports and let us know what you think about Necroball by leaving a review!

PATCH NOTES 1.2

- Player names should now always show up in multiplayer matches
- Version difference stops the client from joining a match and gives an error message.
- Shadows no longer spawn in the middle of the screen for the client.
- Brunhilde can correctly shoot over ice wall if playing as the client.
- Changed mouse mechanic - now all mouse movement affects reticle
- Removed Unity Splash Screen
- Latency indicator added to in-game portraits
- Added mouse sensitivity slider to options
- Mouse sensitivity and outlines on/off now set by player rather than by match
- Jack's Lightning Rod now correctly affects players.
- Necrocorgi charge-up ability increases minion spawns much more and increases minion speed
- Horde power-up removed from Survival Mode
- Friendly minions removed from Survival Mode
- Ultimate minions and Big Shadow minions have had their HP reduced
- Some crash bugs have been solved
- De-sync issue with the Necroball in multiplayer matches improved

Thanks for playing!

-King Crow Studios

notes.title: Update 1.1 - Survival Mode Added! 1/17/17
notes.content:
Hello Everybody!

Today we added in Survival Mode for Necroball!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27366159/6d07f144572d64037935097fb3d22d497224933f.png[/img]

You'll face several waves of enemy minions while you try to keep them out of your goal and survive until the end!

All you have to do is start a game with just one player in the lobby, or everyone on the same team if you want to do co-op, and you'll activate Survival Mode and choose your enemy horde to face.

Please let us know what you think about the new Survival Mode and we'll continue modifying and polishing the existing mechanics in the game.

Speaking of modifying and polishing mechanics, here is our first list of patch notes!

PATCH NOTES 1.1

- Survival Mode added! Play alone or with friends against hordes of enemy minions!
- Zuzu's summoning circle ability no longer allows you, or the Necroball, to jump out of bounds.
- If another player leaves the lobby while the other players are "Ready" it no longer forces the "Ready" players to back out and rejoin.
- Error message now appears when you are disconnected from a multiplayer game due to latency.
- Levels should update automatically when you go back to the lobby, instead of having to exit and recreate the lobby to see the changes. (This bug seems to have spawned some other smaller level tracking bugs we are working on)
- You can now select Yes or No with the controller when trying to Quit Game.
- Game no longer uses the Unity icon when playing.
- Added in Windowed Mode option to Options > Graphic Settings.
- You can now scroll between characters while looking at their character info in the lobby.
- There is now a Controls Screen option in the Options menu.
- Changed flashing text in the lobby from "Press Start or A to Join" to "Press Start or Enter to Join"

Thanks for playing!

-King Crow Studios
